title: Nolita Large Pebbled Leather Hobo Shoulder Bag
description_html:
Nolita Large Pebbled Leather Hobo Shoulder Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 15.75”W X 17.255”H X 3.5”D
  • Handle Drop: Handle drop: 10.75”
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Pebbled leather
  • Hardware: Silver-tone hardware
  • Lining: 55% polyester/45% linen
  • Closure: Snap fastening
